name: Catena
source:
The devil who first contracted with the main character.
She has a cautious personality and is also a staff member for the main character.
Ability is "restraint". It is possible to freely control "chains" that cannot be broken by human power, and to instantly capture objects in sight.
translation:
The devil who first contracted with the main character.
